description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling SSL certificates, including encoding certificates to strings, reading certificates from file content, and parsing the common name from a certificate.

classes.name: SslUtil
classes.description: A utility class for SSL certificate operations such as encoding, decoding, and parsing certificates.

methods.name: getCertificateString
methods.description: Encodes a certificate to a Base64 string and trims new lines.

methods.name: getCertificateChainString
methods.description: Converts a chain of certificates into a concatenated string with PEM headers.

methods.name: readCertFile
methods.description: Reads a certificate from a string content, decoding from Base64 and creating an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: parseCommonName
methods.description: Extracts the Common Name (CN) from an X509Certificate.
